title: How to Make 3 EASY Paper Airplanes that Fly Far — Best Planes in the World — Dagger, F-15, Arrowhead
description:
Fold three of the best paper airplanes in the world! These things fly to the far side of the gym and hit the back wall!

Get the book: https://amzn.to/2M5L5D5
International Buyers: https://www.FoldableFlight.com/shop

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/foldableflight 

Facebook: https://www.Facebook.com/FoldableFlight

Music: Flight by Gabrielle Grubbs

Arrowhead:
Materials: US Letter ( 8.5 in x11 in ) Paper
Difficulty: Easy

F-15 Jet:
Materials: US Letter ( 8.5 in x11 in ) Paper and Scissors
Difficulty: Easy

Dagger:
